company.description: Rain is an operator of digital currency exchange and custodian intended to make digital transactions. It was founded in 2017 and is based in Manama, Al Manamah, Bahrain. Rain is a regulated cryptocurrency exchange platform operating in the Middle East that allows users to buy, sell, and store digital assets like Bitcoin and Ethereum in a secure environment. It’s known for being one of the first crypto trading platforms licensed by a central bank in the Middle East, focusing on compliance, security, and easy access to crypto investing. Users can trade major cryptocurrencies, manage portfolios, and use custodial wallet services through its app or website.
